title: Placing an Employer Allowance Lot on an Employee Meal Account
content:
Where an employer funds meals for its staff, that funding reaches the diner as an allowance lot placed on their Employee Meal Account for the grant period then due. This page governs the placing of such a lot and the value it carries.

## What it governs

What is governed here is the employer allowance placed on the account in one lot. Once the lot is on the account the employee can spend it at the counter straight away, and the unspent employer allowance standing on the account stands higher by the value granted.

## Booking it

The desk unlocks the agent tool `grant_daily_allowance_lot_ed948b99` and calls it. The call books an allowance grant entry on the account's transaction ledger for the value stated, mints the allowance lot reference that entry is traced under, and raises the unspent employer allowance standing on the account by the same value.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `meal_account_id` | The reference number of the Employee Meal Account the allowance lot is placed on | An account reference, read from the meal account lookup before the call |
| `granted_amount_usd` | The employer allowance placed on the account in this lot, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and rounded half to even at that precision; stored as a positive magnitude; an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the allowance lot reference minted for this grant, the value granted in USD to two decimal places and the unspent employer allowance standing on the account afterwards. The presence of that lot reference is what indicates the grant completed.

## Basis Q&A

**Whose action is this?** The desk's own; the tool is an agent tool, unlocked and called by the agent handling the account.

**What is the lot reference for?** It is the reference this grant is traced under, minted by the call and named back in the confirmation.

**What does the employee see?** A higher unspent employer allowance on the account, spendable at the counter straight away.
